battle.name: 第二次西西里奴隸起義
battle.theater: 西西里北部哈拉埃薩與埃里克斯山
battle.brief: 公元前104年，西西里島北部哈拉埃薩周邊大莊園的牧奴起事，克萊昂自稱王、迦太基裔特律豐任統帥，義軍席捲莊園與礦區。羅馬總督奧勒斯特斯調兵圍剿，誘捕二首領押往羅馬處死，餘眾被轉賣為奴。卡面秦連弩為東亞連發弩機，從未進入地中海，此處借它說明守城方以連射火力壓住攻城者的道理。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 公元前104年爆發的第二次西西里奴隸起義，交戰的雙方並非國家，而是羅馬共和國與西西里島上的奴隸武裝。義軍主體是散居於巨型莊園的奴隸隊伍，核心在島北哈拉埃薩一帶的牧場與農莊，族裔以迦太基、希臘與敘利亞出身者為多，另有自羅馬城邦及意大利各地賣入島內的戰俘；少數自由民亦在莊園高壓與債務奴役之下加入行列。羅馬方面由元老院直接指揮，駐島的先遣部隊遭伏而潰敗，隨後升級為執政官級的遠征大軍，由西西里總督馬可·奧勒斯特斯與使節薩爾維迪努斯（姓名在傳世抄本中略有出入）共同統率。島上五座拉丁同盟城市——墨西拿、陶羅梅尼翁、阿克拉加斯、塞巴斯托與哈利恰耶——提供基地、糧秣與援兵，其餘西西里城市多站在羅馬一邊，但也有城市因恐懼或報復而遭到義軍襲擊。全程沒有第三國介入，沒有海外援助，也沒有形成任何跨海聯盟，這是一場行省內部的大型叛亂與鎮壓。
countriesEn: The Second Sicilian Slave War broke out in 104 BC. The two sides were not states at all, but the Roman Republic on the one hand and an armed body of enslaved Sicilians on the other. The insurgents were drawn principally from the labour gangs of the great estates, with their core in the pastures and farms around Halaesa in the north of the island, and were of mixed ethnic origin, predominantly Carthaginian, Greek and Syrian, together with war captives sold into the island from Rome and from Italy; a few free men also fell in under the pressure of the estates and of debt-bondage. Rome acted through the senate: the first detachment stationed on the island was ambushed and destroyed, and the senate then escalated to a field army of consular scale, commanded jointly by the governor of Sicily, Marcus Aurelius Orestes, and the legate Salvidienus, whose name survives in the transmitted manuscripts in slightly varying forms. The five Latin communities of the island, Messana, Tauromenium, Akragas, Segesta and Halicyae, supplied bases, provisions and reinforcements, and most of the remaining Sicilian cities sided with Rome, although some were attacked by the insurgents out of fear or revenge. No third country intervened at any point, there was no overseas assistance, and no alliance was formed across the sea: this was, from beginning to end, a large provincial rebellion and its suppression.
people: 義軍方面的名字留下兩個。克萊昂是哈拉埃薩區一名大莊園的牧奴，出身奴籍，族屬在古記錄中並不確定；他在一次夢境中自見受命為王，告知同伴後被擁立為首，率眾殺死莊上的監工、奪取武器與糧食，把莊園經營多年積蓄的械具變成起義軍的第一批裝備。特律豐則是迦太基血統、曾受過僱兵式軍事訓練而淪為奴隸的人，見義軍勢起便加入；他擅長統兵與演練，組織紀律、布置哨戒、訓練騎兵，實際上成為這支部隊的軍事首腦，很快在軍中聲望超過克萊昂，兩人由合作轉為猜忌，最終分道揚鑣，義軍也隨之分成數股。羅馬方面，奧勒斯特斯是西西里的最高行政長官，此役之後以鎮壓之功獲得不尋常的權力與民望，日後更因爭取執政官權而在公元132年被禁衛軍殺死，留下一段反諷的餘波；使節薩爾維迪努斯則代表元老院主持談判。義軍被平定後，兩名首領在落入羅馬手中的談判現場被拘押，押往羅馬受刑：克萊昂被釘上十字架，特律豐在示眾與羞辱之後被斬首，兩人的姓名從此成為西西里莊園與奴群之間流傳的警戒。
peopleEn: Two names survive on the insurgent side. Cleon was a cowherd on a large estate in the district of Halaesa, born into slavery, his ethnic origin not fixed by the ancient record; in a dream he saw himself invested with kingship, told his fellows, and was raised as leader, killing the overseers of the estate, taking its weapons and its stores of food, and turning the tools accumulated over years of careful farming into the first equipment of the rebel force. Tryphon was of Carthaginian blood, had received mercenary military training before falling into slavery, and joined the rising when he saw it gather momentum; skilled at command and drill, he organised the discipline, laid out pickets and trained the cavalry, and became in practice the military head of the force, soon outranked in the army's esteem by Cleon himself, the two men turning from collaboration to mutual suspicion and finally parting, the movement splitting into several bands. On the Roman side, Orestes was the senior civil magistrate of Sicily and after this campaign gained an unusual share of power and prestige from the suppression; he later pushed his claim to the tribunician power and was killed by the Praetorian Guard in AD 132, leaving an ironic sequel. The legate Salvidienus conducted the negotiations on behalf of the senate. After the rising was put down, the two leaders were seized at the very place of parley where they fell into Roman hands and were taken to Rome for their punishment: Cleon was crucified, Tryphon was beheaded after public humiliation and parade, and from that day their names passed through the estates and the slave gangs of Sicily as a standing warning.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩：一具以弩機儲存拉力、踏板一放即發的連發弩機，矢匣裝矢，一腳一矢，靠機括反覆上弦連射。嚴格說，連發弩機的成熟形制在中國是較晚的產物，秦時已有的弩是強力的手拉弩，弩機、望山與附件齊備；卡面所呈現的，是把蓄力機構與扳動機括合為一體的連射概念。放到這場戰爭裡，它沒有出現在西西里——地中海沒有秦弩，也沒有任何一支中國軍隊踏上過西西里島——但它精確標示出這場攻防中的一個關鍵技術問題：如何讓投射火力在沒有持續補充兵員的情況下連續壓住城牆外或山道上的敵人。功能上最接近的是羅馬的凱羅弩炮（cheiroballista）與固定式大型弩炮（ballista），同樣是預儲扭力、逐矢擊發，大的用來遠射壓制，小的用來在城頭近距快射；起義軍在缺乏弩炮的哈拉埃薩山寨裡，靠投石手、擲石、弓矢與火油從高處傾瀉，性質上正是這種以壓制換取時間的守城邏輯，只是器材臨時湊成。義軍裝備以莊園器具為主：鋤、斧、耙、削尖木矛、漁叉、獵弓，加上奪來的羅馬式短劍、標槍與盾牌；羅馬方面則是全套制式裝備，長劍、標槍、大盾、頭盔、鎖子甲、攻城塔、撞槌，以及由牛馬拖曳的攻城器械與隨軍工匠。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow: a machine in which the trigger mechanism stores the draw, and a treadle releases one bolt per step, with a magazine of bolts fed from a case and the string re-set automatically by the mechanism for shot after shot. Strictly speaking, the mature form of the repeating crossbow is a later Chinese product; the crossbows of the Qin period were powerful hand-drawn weapons with a full set of trigger box, sight and fittings, and what the card shows is the concept of combining the power-storage device with a repeating release. Placed in this war, it was of course absent from Sicily: the Mediterranean had no Qin crossbow and no Chinese army ever set foot on the island. Yet it marks exactly the technical problem of this particular siege: how to keep a volume of missile fire on an enemy outside the wall, or on a mountain road, without continuously manning the machine with fresh crews. The closest functional counterparts in the Mediterranean are the Roman cheiroballista and the large fixed ballista, both of which store torsion in advance and discharge bolt by bolt, the larger for long-range suppression and the smaller for fast close-range shooting from the parapet. The insurgents at the hill-fort of Halaesa, having no artillery at all, relied on slingers, stones, bows and fire-pots poured down from the heights; the logic was the same, that of buying time with suppression, but the equipment was improvised. The rebel armoury was drawn from farm implements: hoes, axes, rakes, sharpened wooden spears, fish-tridents and hunting bows, together with Roman-style short swords, javelins and shields taken by force; the Romans, for their part, brought the full regulation kit, long swords, javelins, the large shield, helmets, mail, siege towers, battering rams, and the ox-drawn siege engines with their attendant engineers.
tactics: 起義的爆發靠的是同時性與奇襲。克萊昂在莊園一處策動，四面八方的奴工在同一天夜裡動手：燒掉莊舍、殺死監工、打開武器庫，把糧食與牲畜趕進山中的堡壘，短時間內形成一支有佔領區、有儲糧據點的武裝。進入山區後，義軍放棄正面會戰，改以游擊與襲擾為主：特律豐把散兵整編成有旗號的隊伍，在隘口與谷地設伏，騎兵下到平原搶奪收成、切斷鄉村道路，使羅馬遠征軍的糧秣只能靠海運或強制徵集。羅馬最初的教訓是低估對手：先遣隊在島內遭伏，損失慘重，迫使元老院升級為執政官級大軍。到了攻城階段，羅馬放棄急攻，改採圍城與工事：修築包圍牆切斷要塞對外的通道，設置投射兵器陣地，以弩炮與投石機壓制牆頭守軍，夜間以突擊消耗守軍，同時派人進山散播寬免與授田的說法。最終取勝的則是一次外交欺騙：奧勒斯特斯提出只要繳械便可獲得自由並分得土地，義軍領導層相信而赴會，羅馬人遂在會談地點將克萊昂與特律豐拘押，隨即分兵掃清山寨殘部，餘眾或死或被解為奴隸。
tacticsEn: The outbreak of the rising rested on simultaneity and surprise. Cleon set it in motion in one quarter of the estate, and the slaves of the surrounding country moved on the same night: farm buildings were burned, the overseers killed, the armoury opened, and food and cattle driven up into the fortified heights, so that within a very short time there existed an armed force with an occupied district and defended stores of grain. Once in the mountains the insurgents gave up set-piece battle and took to harassment: Tryphon drilled the loose bands into units with their own banners, posted them in ambush at the passes and gullies, and sent the cavalry down onto the plains to seize the harvest and cut the country roads, so that the Roman field army could draw its food only by sea or by forced requisition. Rome's first lesson was to underestimate the enemy: the first detachment was ambushed inside the island and badly mauled, which forced the senate to escalate to a consular field army. In the siege phase Rome abandoned the assault and adopted blockade and engineering: a circumvallation wall was built to cut the fortress off from the outside, positions for missile artillery were established, bolt-throwers and stone-throwers kept the defenders on the parapet under fire, night attacks wore the garrison down, and emissaries were sent into the hills to spread promises of pardon and of allotments of land. What finally decided the matter was a diplomatic deception: Orestes offered that the slaves lay down their arms and would receive their freedom and a share of the land, the insurgent leaders believed him and came to the conference, and the Romans there and then seized Cleon and Tryphon, after which the mountain bands were swept out, the survivors being killed or sold back into slavery.
data: 這場戰爭的年表清楚而數字稀少。起義爆發於公元前104年，至前102年被平定，歷時約兩年，是第一次西西里奴隸起義（前135至前132年）之後相隔約三十年的第二次大規模武裝抗爭。義軍的峰值人數沒有留下可信的總數，狄奧多羅斯《歷史文庫》只說起義者聚集到數萬之眾，其中步兵以萬計，另有自莊園趕出的牛馬改作騎兵之用；被平定後遭解為奴隸、發賣並送入島上礦場苦役的總數同樣只有概數。羅馬方面投入的是執政官級遠征軍，按共和國常備編制推算約兩萬至三萬人，含兩個軍團的步兵、一支羅馬騎兵、盟邦與拉丁城市的援軍，另有工匠與攻城器械隊。地理上，哈拉埃薩距墨西拿約六十公里，位於內布羅迪山脈西麓的丘陵地帶，道路狹窄不宜大軍展開，羅馬軍隊的實際集結與補給基地在島北港口。島上莊園經濟以產穀、產油與開採硫磺礦為主，奴工比例極高，這正是狄奧多羅斯在記述起義背景時提到的財富集中與莊園主殘酷的經濟實態。
dataEn: The chronology of this war is clear and the figures are scarce. The rising broke out in 104 BC and was put down in 102 BC, roughly two years in all, and it was the second large armed resistance in Sicily in about thirty years after the first Sicilian slave revolt of 135 to 132 BC. No reliable total survives for the peak strength of the insurgents: Diodorus Siculus, in the Library of History, says only that the rebels gathered to tens of thousands, with the infantry numbered in thousands more, and that cattle taken from the estates were turned to use as cavalry. The total number sold back into slavery, sent out to the mines of the island and put to hard labour after the suppression is likewise given only in general terms. On the Roman side the force committed was a field army of consular scale, which on the regular organisation of the Republic works out at roughly twenty to thirty thousand men, including the infantry of two legions, a Roman cavalry, contingents from the Italian allies and the Latin cities, and a body of engineers with the siege trains. Geographically Halaesa lies about sixty kilometres from Messana, in the foothills of the Nebrodi range, where the roads are narrow and unsuited to the deployment of a mass army, and the real assembly and supply base of the Roman troops lay in the ports of the northern coast. The estate economy of the island turned on grain, oil and the working of the sulphur mines, and the proportion of slave labour was extremely high, which is precisely the concentration of wealth and the cruelty of the great proprietors that Diodorus sets behind his narrative of the revolt.
cause: 起義的成因可以分三層看。其一是結構性的：前二世紀以來西西里形成巨型莊園，耕地高度集中，農民失地淪為債務奴隸或賣身為奴，島上奴隸人口多過自由人口，任何歉收、稅負或莊園監工的一次暴行都可能點燃全島。其二是政治性的：前132年第一次起義之後，羅馬只由十人委員會做過有限度的土地勘察與安置，莊園制度本身並未動搖；此後數十年，島上奴隸占壓倒多數，羅馬卻一面把西西里當作可以安插退伍軍人與貪墨官員的獎賞地，一面對莊園主的剝削睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。其三是偶然性的引爆：克萊昂所受的那場夢、莊園監工的私刑、以及某次同時爆發的縱火，把積壓的不滿一次釋放。當時羅馬正同時陷於北非的朱古利達戰爭與高盧的辛布里戰役，駐西西里的守備薄弱，遠征能力有限，元老院沒有及時壓制，讓起義得以蔓延成整座島嶼的叛亂。
causeEn: The causes of the revolt can be read on three levels. The first is structural: from the second century BC Sicily formed enormous estates, land became highly concentrated, and peasants who lost their holdings were swallowed up as debt-bonded servants or sold into slavery, so that on the island the slave population outnumbered the free; any bad harvest, any new tax, or any single act of violence by an estate overseer could set the whole island alight. The second is political: after the first revolt of 135 to 132 BC, Rome did no more than send a commission of ten to make a limited survey and settlement of land, and the estate system itself was left untouched; for the decades that followed the slaves remained in overwhelming majority on the island, while Rome treated Sicily both as a place in which to settle discharged soldiers and to enrich venal officials, and as a field in which to turn a blind eye to the exploitation of the great proprietors. The third level is the accidental trigger: the dream that came to Cleon, the private justice meted out by an estate overseer, and one outbreak of arson that released at a single stroke the accumulated disaffection. At the time Rome was committed simultaneously in North Africa against Jugurtha and in Gaul against the Cimbri, the garrison in Sicily was thin, the capacity for expedition was limited, and the senate did not move in time, allowing the revolt to spread into a rebellion of the whole island.
impact: 影響要分當時與後世來看。當時，這場起義第二次證明奴隸大規模起事可以升級為一場有編制、有戰術的戰爭，義軍裡出現了會用騎兵、會設伏、會自建要塞的指揮者，這迫使羅馬此後把鎮壓外省奴隸暴動當作執政官級的國務，而不是地方治安的插曲；西西里此後常駐軍團，五座拉丁城市被強化為羅馬在島上的支撐點，總督的行政與財政行為也屢屢被元老院追究，維爾雷斯在公元前70年代被控貪瀆西西里，就是這條線的終點。後世，這場戰爭與前一次並肩，成為羅馬人記憶中最殘酷的一對：羅馬答應繳械者得自由與土地，卻在會議桌前下手，並把大批餘眾重新變成奴隸。這種背信不只在島上留下恐懼，也讓「解放」的說法在西西里與意大利的奴群中失去說服力，直接餵養了日後斯巴達克斯起義時的絕望情緒，並在羅馬的思想裡留下一個長期的爭議：土地兼併、大莊園與奴役的關係究竟該如何處理。此外，這場戰爭也讓地中海的奴隸市場重新洗牌，被解為奴隸的西西里人被四處發賣，羅馬的家內奴隸因此獲得一批來自最熟悉羅馬兵制的島民的成員。
impactEn: The effects have to be read both at the time and afterwards. At the time, this rising demonstrated for a second time that a mass slave revolt could be upgraded into a war with organisation and method: the insurgents now had commanders who used cavalry, who laid ambushes and who built their own strongholds, and from then on Rome treated the suppression of provincial slave risings as a matter of state requiring a consular army rather than as an incident of local policing. A garrison was permanently stationed in Sicily, the five Latin cities were reinforced as Rome's points of support on the island, and the administrative and financial conduct of the governors came repeatedly under senatorial scrutiny; the prosecution of Verres for his administration of Sicily in the seventies of the last century BC is the end of that line. For posterity, this war and the one before it stand as the cruellest pair in Roman memory: Rome had promised freedom and land to those who laid down their arms, then struck at the conference table, and turned a great mass of survivors back into slaves. That breach of faith left fear on the island and deprived the word of emancipation of all persuasiveness among the slave populations of Sicily and Italy, feeding directly the despair that would surface in Spartacus; it also left in Roman thought a long-running argument about how land consolidation, the great estate and slavery were to be reconciled. The war additionally reshuffled the Mediterranean slave market, the Sicilians sold back into slavery being dispersed to the buyers, so that the household slaves of Rome itself acquired a body of men who knew the Roman military system better than anyone.
result: 結果是羅馬的勝利。公元前102年，哈拉埃薩一帶的義軍主力在圍城與分化之下崩解，兩名首領克萊昂與特律豐先被誘出、拘押，再押往羅馬公開處刑：克萊昂被釘死，特律豐被斬首示眾，留在山中的隊伍在失去指揮後被逐一清剿，倖存者被解為奴隸發賣，一部分被送進島上的礦坑與硫磺礦做苦役，一部分被分給拉丁城市與軍戶。這場勝利並沒有解決問題：島上莊園制度原封不動，奴隸人口比例幾乎未減，前132年那樣的安置從未在此重演，羅馬只是以更大的駐軍與更高的壓制代價維持秩序。對起義者而言，他們沒有得到國家、沒有得到土地，也沒有得到自由的可見實質；對羅馬而言，這次平叛加上第一次起義共消耗了兩個執政官級的遠征，卻在國內政治上留下一個陰影：每一次鎮壓的殘酷，都可能成為下一次動亂的號角。
resultEn: The result was a Roman victory. In 102 BC the main body of the insurgents around Halaesa disintegrated under blockade and division; the two leaders, Cleon and Tryphon, were first lured out and seized and then taken to Rome for public execution: Cleon was crucified, Tryphon was beheaded and paraded in ignominy, and the bands left in the mountains were hunted out one by one after the loss of their command, the survivors being sold back into slavery, some sent to work in the pits and the sulphur mines of the island and some distributed to the Latin cities and to soldiers. The victory settled nothing: the estate system of the island remained exactly as it was, the proportion of slaves in the population was scarcely reduced, no settlement of the kind granted in 132 BC was repeated here, and Rome simply maintained order at the price of larger garrisons and heavier repression. For the insurgents it brought no state, no land and no visible substance of freedom; for Rome, this suppression and the one before it between them consumed two consular expeditions, yet left a shadow in domestic politics: every brutal repression could sound the knell of the next rising.
